subject: general
question: Which among the following companies made an Initial Public Offering (IPO) in Indian stock market in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adani Wilmar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Adani Wilmar made an Initial Public Offering (IPO) in the Indian stock market in 2022 and raised ₹3,600 crore
 
• Adani Wilmar is a food and FMCG company that was founded in 1991.
 
• The IPO was subscribed 112 times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Initial Public offering (IPO)**

 
• An initial public offering (IPO) is the first time that the stock of a private company is offered to the public. 
 
• Initial public offering is the process by which a private company can go public by sale of its stocks to general public.
 
• It could be a new, young company or an old company that decides to be listed on an exchange and hence goes public.
 
• Companies can raise equity capital with the help of an IPO by issuing new shares to the public, or the existing shareholders can sell their shares to the public without raising any fresh capital.
